items.title: EBAY Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: While the market sees a legacy platform, a newer eBay is emerging from within. The company's focused categories, from luxury goods to auto parts, are quietly becoming the core business. This specific segment grew 26% last quarter and for the first time eclipsed 40% of total gross merchandise volume.

items.title: Victory Marine Holdings Appoints E-Commerce Director to Scale GUTSI Omnichannel Growth
items.summary: Victory Marine Holdings has appointed Miles Bodie as Director of E-Commerce at its Dunn & Groux Beverage Holdings subsidiary, adding dedicated leadership to expand GUTSI across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace and direct-to-consumer channels.
